description: Election Commission - Declare that E. C. S. De Zoysa and P. S. W. Vithanage as a members of Kalutara Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government council (Kalutara Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for declaring elected members to fill seats that became vacant due to party membership changes, which falls under election-related matters including candidate nominations and declarations of elected members.
